board: Adafruit LED Arcade Button 1x4 - STEMMA QT I2C Breakout (product 5296)
reason: Check passed on esp32 and pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, PCB DRC). Buttons are modelled as seesaw GPIO_BULK input bits (pins 18, 19, 20, 2, active low) and HW_ID reads 0x87; LED PWM writes (pins 12, 13, 0, 1) are accepted but not shown in the simulator.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-led-arcade-button-qt/pinouts (header photos: VIN, GND, SCL, SDA, INT, UPDI) and schematic https://cdn-learn.adafruit.com/assets/assets/000/108/567/large1024/adafruit_products_AQT_sch.png
